dedupe_keys.name: seychelles pre cyclone potential coconut plantations zones

description: Seychelles - Pre-Cyclone Potential Coconut Plantations Zones is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected potential Coconut plantations areas in Farquhar atoll in Seychelles before the Fantala-16 tropical cyclone of the 18 April 2016. Using a Worldview-2 satellite image acquired the 01 February 2016, UNITAR - UNOSAT identified ~250 ha of potential areas with coconut trees. Coverage: Seychelles. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
